title: Signal
summary: Electric blue, crisp type, and a dark canvas.
guidance: Keep authored content, layout, narration, motion and timing. The treatment sets the root background, ink and font. For intentional surfaces use data-sl-surface; use data-sl-heading, data-sl-muted, data-sl-accent and data-sl-fill for palette roles. Existing explicit child colours/backgrounds remain authored unless assigned a role. Check stills for contrast. Fonts use local fallbacks; package project fonts for portability. Preserve the pinned style block on HTML edits. Project instructions take priority.
